name: @superschematic/http-runtime
description: Runtime for generated TypeScript API servers: request context, RFC 9457 problem envelope, success envelope, parameter decoding over the superscalar scalar functions, the permission gate, the service-caller verifier and credential sources, a token-bucket rate limiter, the Hono adapter, the readers of the config fields a stack derives, a JSON-lines logger, a pg Pool over a derived database connection (./postgres), and the provider-neutral Bucket with its GCS implementation (./gcs). Ships compiled ESM with declarations. Needs superscalar next to it in node_modules; see scripts/link-local-deps.mjs.

scripts.build: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun test src
